import more_itertools as mi

expected = [tuple(x) for x in [["ChunkedTests","test_even"],["ChunkedTests","test_negative"],["ChunkedTests","test_none"],["ChunkedTests","test_odd"],["ChunkedTests","test_strict_being_true"],["ChunkedTests","test_strict_being_true_with_size_none"],["ChunkedTests","test_strict_false"],["FirstTests","test_default"],["FirstTests","test_empty"],["FirstTests","test_many"],["FirstTests","test_one"],["LastTests","test_basic"],["LastTests","test_default"],["LastTests","test_empty"],["LastTests","test_reversed_is_none"],["SplitAfterTest","test_empty_collection"],["SplitAfterTest","test_ends_with_sep"],["SplitAfterTest","test_max_split"],["SplitAfterTest","test_no_sep"],["SplitAfterTest","test_starts_with_sep"]]]
tree = ast.parse(Path("tests/test_more.py").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
for node in ast.walk(tree):
    if hasattr(node, "type_params"):
        node._fields = tuple(x for x in node._fields if x != "type_params")
classes = {c.name: c for c in tree.body if isinstance(c, ast.ClassDef)}
rows = []
for cls, name in expected:
    methods = {m.name: m for m in classes[cls].body if isinstance(m, ast.FunctionDef)}
    rows.append((cls, name, ast.dump(methods[name], include_attributes=False)))
digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(rows), ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
assert digest == "2d3cb89c75b94ad611245c78e35854e6fb7fda9055751153922fd384a4dc5795", "original regression methods changed"
from tests.test_more import FirstTests, LastTests, SplitAfterTest, ChunkedTests
loader = unittest.TestLoader()
suite = unittest.TestSuite(loader.loadTestsFromTestCase(c) for c in (FirstTests, LastTests, SplitAfterTest, ChunkedTests))
assert suite.countTestCases() >= 20, "upstream regression methods must remain intact"
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
assert result.wasSuccessful()
assert not any((type(t).__name__, t._testMethodName) in expected for t, reason in result.skipped), "original regression cannot be skipped"
assert mi.first([None, 2]) is None
assert mi.last(iter([1, 0])) == 0
assert list(mi.split_after([1, 0, 2, 0], lambda x: x == 0)) == [[1, 0], [2, 0]]
assert list(mi.chunked(range(5), 2)) == [[0, 1], [2, 3], [4]]
print("frozen upstream compatibility regressions passed")
'
